headline: Triveni Engineering receives NSE and BSE approvals for TPTL listing
hook: New shares find a public market
summary: Triveni Engineering & Industries has received final listing and trading approvals from both the BSE and NSE for its demerged entity, Triveni Power Transmission Limited (TPTL). Shareholders of Triveni Engineering are set to unlock distinct value following the formal incorporation and exchange debut of the power transmission business. This corporate restructuring allows investors to hold direct stakes in the distinct engineering arm. Retail holders of Triveni Engineering should note how this unbundling alters the parent company's consolidated balance sheet and book value.
whats_next: Trading commencement date announcement by BSE and NSE
why_it_matters: TPTL shares soon trade separately on your terminal.

headline: Triveni Engineering submits quarterly depository certificate
summary: Triveni Engineering & Industries Limited has filed its compliance certificate under Regulation 74(5) of SEBI (Depositories and Participants) Regulations for the quarter ended September 30, 2026. This document confirms the dematerialization of securities and the destruction of physical certificates as required by law. It is a standard procedural filing for listed companies.
